decision_owner: managing agent under the user's routine-operation delegation
question: Does a compact source-linked roadmap briefing preserve the facts required for sequencing that the existing initiative representation carries?
selection: O1 i2 (12 terminal cases: 9 merged, 1 provider/tool failure, 2 unknown) neither supports nor displaces the B1 candidate; it is kept because it needs zero provider calls and exercises the isolation boundary.
baseline: existing initiative representation: `factory evidence` investigate initiative <initiative> JSON, captured on the host from the pinned source before rendering
candidate: minimal briefing renderer (case.py) run inside the sandbox over the frozen baseline

oracle.derived_from: raw `gh issue view` JSON of the initiative, its Implementation links and their declared blockers, frozen before rendering

facts.tier: first NOW/NEXT/THEN/LATER Plan line naming a linked ticket
facts.state: OPEN or CLOSED for every linked ticket
facts.held: factory-held label present, for OPEN linked tickets
facts.open_blockers: `Blocked by:` lines of OPEN linked tickets whose blocker is OPEN (possibly none)

decision_criterion: candidate retains every oracle fact with a resolvable citation and makes no unsupported claim; bytes and omissions are measured, compactness is not correctness

isolation.mechanism: bubblewrap: new user/pid/net/ipc/uts/cgroup namespaces, --disable-userns, --clearenv, read-only /usr, private /tmp and /home, no /run, /etc, /sys or host home; transient systemd user scope for limits; timeout

mounts./out: private output directory on user tmpfs

isolation.on_failure: invalid; never fall back to host execution
